title: zodTextFormat with Zod 4 fails: schema must be a JSON Schema of type object, got type string
symptoms: Invalid schema for response_format: schema must be a JSON Schema of 'type: "object"', got 'type: "string"'.
The structured outputs example from the docs fails after installing the latest zod
cause: Before 6.7.0 the SDK converted schemas with a library that only understood Zod 3, so Zod 4 objects turned into a wrong schema.
fix: Upgrade openai to 6.7.0 or later, or pin zod to version 3.
affected: openai-node earlier than 6.7.0 with zod 4; fixed in 6.7.0, 2025-10-24
